findings.text: REQ-4 is marked known but adds a condition the ticket does not state: the sum of all doctors' Today counts equals the tile. This holds only if every doctor is summed, including Inactive and filtered-out ones, across all pages.

cites.quote: Reuse the tile's counting rule; impact analysis confirms it excludes only Cancelled
The count includes appointments in any status except `Cancelled`.

findings.text: Q-05's default reuses the tile's rule even if the tile differs. That would contradict known REQ-3 (exclude only Cancelled), which the ticket states explicitly.
